name: General Meeting
description: A balanced report: what was discussed, what was decided, and what happens next.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.instruction: Three to five sentences covering what this meeting was about and what came out of it. Write for someone who did not attend and will not read further.

sections.heading: Key Points
sections.instruction: The substantive points raised, one per bullet. Attribute a point to a speaker only when the transcript makes the speaker clear.

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.instruction: Decisions actually reached, with the reasoning given for each. A topic that was discussed but left open is not a decision — it belongs under Open Questions.

sections.heading: Action Items
sections.instruction: Concrete commitments someone made. Give the owner and any due date stated in the transcript. Do not invent an owner for an unowned task — write 'Unassigned'.

sections.heading: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Questions raised and not resolved. Omit this section entirely if there were none.
